scope: skill shop / TP-STP medal shop canonical endpoint layer
findings: The live canonical skill layer contains 12 Skill Shop records and 11 TP/STP Medal Shop records, for 23 shop-linked skills.
Both shop systems now have stable canonical endpoint IDs and deterministic forward/reverse projections.
Canonical acquisition_type and source_quest_or_shop remain authoritative; alternate routes are retained in the skill records rather than duplicated as unsupported relationships.
Historical rotation/price evidence is preserved as provenance and is not interpreted as current availability.
next_research: Build the equivalent canonical Time Rift/story/tournament endpoint layer.
Expand shop endpoint metadata with dated rotation records where dedicated shop evidence is available.
Keep mentor and Expert Mission endpoint layers aligned with canonical skill IDs.
